pf.license.need: none from the state for teaching CPR and first aid in most places; each instructor holds a current instructor card from a nationally recognized program (the program's own card, which the business shows as its word); where a state agency approves providers for some uses (child care staff, school staff), the business shows only the approvals it really holds
pf.license.who: the business, for its registration and any provider approval; each instructor, for their instructor card and the courses it covers
pf.license.ask: the business registration; each instructor's card: the courses it covers and its end date; the program or training center the business teaches under; any provider approval
pf.license.check: Rosie checks no card, license or approval: each one is the business's own word, shown as that, never as a state license or as checked
pf.license.scope: an instructor is offered only for the courses the business says their card covers
pf.license.blocks: goes live on identity and the business's registration; an instructor is offered once the owner says yes
pf.license.renewals: instructor cards run 2 years: reminded 30 and 7 days before; a card the owner says has lapsed takes that instructor off new classes
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it's sent
pf.license.background: background checks for instructors who teach minors or at schools: the business's own word, where the school or its rules ask

pf.services.shape: class: seats in a scheduled class at the training center, each student with their own seat, their own result and their own completion card; a private class books one instructor for a group, at the center or at the customer's place (flow B)
pf.services.examples: the example training center's own prices (Lee CPR Center), not a standard

list.note: a written test and a skills check; a renewal brings the current card

list.note: a parent or guardian books; the parent drops off and picks up

list.name: Company account seats
list.after: one bill a month to the company

list.name: On-site group class
list.kind: one price per student, with a minimum
list.after: the bill after the class, for the final count
list.capacity: up to 12 students per instructor; a second instructor above 12
list.note: the company gives a room with clear floor space; the instructor brings manikins, AED trainers and supplies

list.name: Family or babysitter class at home
Skills check retest
list.price: free once within 30 days; $30 after that
list.before: nothing taken for the free retest

pf.services.capacity: seats per class set by the program's instructor-to-student and student-to-manikin limits (like 1 instructor and 6 manikins for 12 students); a second instructor adds seats
pf.services.minimum: a public class runs with 3, counted 48 hours before; too few: Sam runs it, or each student gets another date or a full refund
pf.services.waitlist: a full class keeps a waitlist; a freed seat goes by text to one person at a time
pf.services.skills: the courses each instructor's card covers (BLS, Heartsaver, pediatric, instructor courses); languages; teaching minors
pf.services.online: the online part of a blended course is taken on the program's own site, outside Rosie; Rosie books the skills session
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the student must be there
pf.services.results: a student who passes gets their completion card (an eCard by email) within 1 business day; a student who doesn't pass the skills check or written test gets no card that day, a private note, and one free retest within 30 days

beforeTimes: which course, and if it's for a job or a board (some accept only certain programs)
a new card or a renewal (a renewal brings a current card that's still in date)
how many students, for a group or an on-site class
for a blended course: is the online part done
afterTime: each student's full name as it should read on the card, and an email for the card
anything the instructor should know to help, like trouble kneeling, a hearing need or a language
securePage: each student's name, email and, where the program asks, date of birth
a physical limit that affects doing compressions on the floor (it may mean a course completion without a card)
for a student under 18: the parent's OK and who picks them up
for a company's student: whether the company may see their attendance and card
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a student under 18 (12 and up for CPR courses, 11 to 15 for the babysitter course); a company's contact for named staff, each of whom gets their own card
pf.questions.told: the course, the length, that the whole class must be attended, and what a card needs: passing the skills check (and the written test where the course has one)

stop.words: someone collapsed or not breathing right now, choking, chest pain, a stroke sign
stop.say: Call 911 now. Start CPR if they're not breathing normally, and use an AED if one is near.

goOn.words: pregnant, a bad knee or back, a recent surgery
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the instructor helps with ways to practice; a card needs the skills the program requires; Rosie gives no health advice

goOn.words: a student booking after a recent death or a scary event
goOn.what: the booking goes on, kindly; crisis words get the crisis line

pf.safety.inClass: a student or anyone at the class becomes unwell: the instructor calls 911 and gives care, then Sam is told; nothing about it goes in a text

steps.name: Blended course: the online part
steps.when: due 24 hours before the skills session
steps.result: the certificate uploaded on the secure page; not in time: the session moves to a later date, free once

steps.name: Renewal: the current card
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: a card still in date is shown at check-in; an expired one is a full course

steps.name: On-site class: the final student list
steps.result: the final list, with each name as it should read on the card, sets the bill; late: the owner is told, and nothing is cancelled for it

steps.name: Under 18: the parent's OK
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: no OK: the student isn't booked

pf.first_steps.prep: wear clothes you can kneel in; bring a photo ID (the card's name is checked against it); bring the online certificate for a blended course

pf.visit.checkIn: the instructor ticks each student on the class roster, or takes each student's own code; an on-site class checks in on the company's list
pf.visit.lateEntry: the program needs every student there for the whole class: up to 10 minutes late may join; later moves to another class, free once
pf.visit.result: at the end the instructor marks each student passed, or needs a retest, on the secure page; cards are issued only for those who passed
pf.visit.changes: an extra student added on site is priced at the per-student rate, and the company says yes first
pf.visit.done: the instructor texts DONE once the roster and the results are in

pf.money.before: public classes paid in full when booking; company accounts nothing before, billed once a month; on-site classes nothing before, billed after for the final count, at least the minimum; a family class at home paid in full
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel or move up to 48 hours before; later, or a no-show, the class price may be kept, only with Sam's yes; a late arrival moved to another class free once
pf.money.retest: the first retest within 30 days is free; later retests $30
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many students

pf.messages.never: test results (passed or not), health or physical limits, dates of birth: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the instructor's day list shows the class and the number of students; names open on the secure page
pf.messages.employer: a company that booked sees who attended and their cards only with each student's OK on the secure page; never the test details
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish; classes in other languages where an instructor teaches in them
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each instructor's card for the courses taught, under a program or training center: the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
pf.staff.skills: courses each instructor may teach, languages, teaching minors, on-site travel
pf.staff.ratio: the program's limits: up to 6 students per manikin station and 12 per instructor; a second instructor for larger classes
pf.staff.standIn: another instructor certified for the same course; students in a public class aren't asked; a company that named an instructor is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs company accounts, on-site classes and refunds

pf.rules.program: classes follow the certifying program's content, timing and testing; a card is issued only to a student who passes the program's skills check (and written test where required)
pf.rules.cards: the name on the card matches the student's ID; a card is reissued once, free, for a spelling mistake
pf.rules.records: rosters, results and cards kept as the program requires (at least 3 years), and with the booking for 7 years
pf.rules.workplace: where workplace safety rules require trained responders, the company decides who takes which course; Rosie gives no advice on which course a job needs
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for a class already given
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the class

pf.edges.notPassed: a student who doesn't pass gets no card that day, a private note on the secure page, and one free retest within 30 days
pf.edges.lateCard: a card not issued by the date given: the student is told before that date
pf.edges.employerPays: the company pays; each student gets their own card; the company sees attendance and cards only with the student's OK
pf.edges.tooFew: too few 48 hours before: Sam runs it, or offers another date or a full refund
pf.edges.instructorOut: another certified instructor covers, at the same time
pf.edges.staffShort: a big class's second instructor can't come: the class keeps only the seats one instructor may teach, and the others get another date or a refund
pf.edges.latecomer: more than 10 minutes late: moved to another class, free once
pf.edges.unwell: someone unwell in class: 911 and care first, then Sam; nothing in a text
pf.edges.minors: a parent books; a student under 18 is picked up by the parent or a named adult
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

Base: the Oct 25 test-drive plug-in (work/testdrive/cpr-training.md), kept where verified; re-verified on the REDESIGN 2 master (Oct 27). Sibling: gym (refit R07), class pattern.
D96: no state license, and Rosie checks no instructor card, registration or insurance (pf.license says so; the test-drive's 'checked on the lookup' is removed).
D97: one $2 per booking, no no2 switch. Children: the children fact (teens and babysitter ages 11 to 15), not sensitive.
Money: four paths in the record's terms, each adds up: A list|full|none (a seat paid in full, fee $95 kept only with Sam's OK), A list|none|bill (company seats billed monthly), B list|none|bill (on-site class $85 a student, example 9 students $765, fee the $510 minimum only with Sam's OK, billed after for the final count), B list|full|none (family class at home $300 paid in full). Never a card hold, never a rest on a set day.
Names: Lee CPR Center (flow A) and Lee On-Site CPR (flow B), both of Sam Lee; instructors Teresa and Ivan (A), Ruben and Lucia (B); the example students Alex M., Tessa.
Facts: classes, groups, forms (the online certificate, a parent's OK), waitlist, children, results (pass or fail: the card follows). No switches. Settings: set start times, free cancel until 2 days before.
Not used: plans, packs, memberships, deposits, intro offers, permits, sent-now work, on-call, stays, drop-off, insurance, holds.
The test-drive's gaps (#1 a 'not passed' result with no step, #2 each student's own result and card when a company pays, #3 the online certificate before the session, #5 a crew short, #6 instructor cards checked on the lookup, #8 health in owner texts, #9 a cancel right after training, #10 a named instructor moved on silence, #11 a class called off with only a refund, #12 a minor left at the end of a class) stay in work/gaps/cpr-training.json.
